biography: Dr. Archana Mal has practised dentistry since 2007 and completed her master's specialisation in Periodontics, the care of gums and supporting structures. She welcomes patients of every age and takes time to explain treatment options clearly.
Her approach is patient-centred: listen first, explain each step, and make a plan together. Outside the clinic she is a busy mum who enjoys the gym and exploring new places.
doctor.vision:
Our vision at Floss & Gloss Dental Clinic is to be recognised as a leader in dental healthcare, known for revolutionising patient experiences through innovation, compassion, and unparalleled expertise. We strive to set new standards in oral healthcare by integrating the latest advances in dental technology while maintaining a warm and welcoming environment.

By focusing on individualised treatment plans, we aim to empower our patients with the knowledge and tools necessary for optimal oral health, thus enhancing their overall quality of life. We envision a community where all individuals feel confident in their smiles and are proactive about their dental health. Floss & Gloss Dental Clinic aspires to be at the forefront of fostering lifelong relationships with our patients, built on trust, respect, and mutual well-being.
doctor.mission:
Our mission at Floss & Gloss Dental Clinic is to provide exceptional dental care that prioritises patient comfort, safety, and satisfaction. We are committed to delivering comprehensive dental services that encompass preventive, restorative, and cosmetic dentistry, tailored to meet the unique needs of each patient.

Through the continued adoption of the latest dental technologies, our experienced team of professionals aims to offer high-quality treatments that are both effective and minimally invasive. We focus on creating a supportive and friendly environment where patients feel valued and understood, encouraging open communication and active participation in their dental health journey. Our ultimate goal is to promote long-term oral health, enabling every patient to achieve and maintain a beautiful, healthy smile for life.
doctor.qualityPolicy:
At Floss & Gloss Dental Clinic, our quality policy is centred on providing patient-focused dental care that consistently meets and exceeds expectations. We are dedicated to implementing rigorous standards of clinical excellence and hygiene, ensuring that every procedure is performed with precision and care.

Our commitment to quality involves continuous professional development for our staff to stay abreast of the latest dental research and practices. We employ state-of-the-art equipment and materials, adhering to the highest safety protocols to deliver reliable and durable dental solutions. We actively seek patient feedback to refine our services and enhance patient satisfaction. Through meticulous attention to detail, empathetic care, and unwavering professionalism, we aim to build lasting trust and achieve optimal dental health outcomes for all our patients. Our quality policy is not just about meeting standards but about fostering a culture of continuous improvement and excellence in every aspect of our practice.

seoCopy: Floss & Gloss Dental Clinic welcomes families from Shela, Bopal, South Bopal, Applewoods and Shilaj. The clinic offers preventive, restorative, cosmetic, gum, surgical and paediatric dental care under one roof.
Dr. Archana Mal has practised dentistry since 2007 and holds an MDS in Periodontics. Appointments are planned around clear explanations, careful hygiene and the needs of each patient.

From routine cleaning and fillings to tooth replacement and smile treatments, the first step is a conversation and examination. The dentist will explain suitable options and discuss costs before treatment begins.

faqs.q: What types of dental services do you offer?
faqs.a: The clinic offers preventive, cosmetic, orthodontic, restorative, gum and oral-surgery services, as well as care for children. The dentist can help you choose the right next step after an examination.

faqs.q: What should I expect during my first visit?
faqs.a: The dentist reviews your medical history, examines your teeth and gums, may recommend X-rays when needed, and explains any suggested treatment plan before it begins.

faqs.q: How often should I visit the dentist?
faqs.a: Many people book regular check-ups about every six months. Your dentist may suggest a different schedule based on your oral health and individual needs.

faqs.q: Do you offer easy payment options?
faqs.a: The clinic discusses costs before treatment and offers multiple payment options. Please ask the team about the options currently available.

faqs.q: What are dental implants?
faqs.a: An implant is a titanium post placed in the jaw to support a replacement tooth. An examination is needed to decide whether implants are suitable for you.

faqs.q: How can I improve my oral hygiene at home?
faqs.a: Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste, clean between your teeth daily, and ask your dentist for advice tailored to your mouth and health needs.

faqs.q: Do you treat children?
faqs.a: Yes. The clinic provides paediatric dental care and aims to make visits comfortable and positive for children and their families.

faqs.q: What is teeth whitening, and is it safe?
faqs.a: Whitening is a cosmetic treatment intended to lighten tooth colour. A dentist can check your teeth and gums and explain suitable options and risks before treatment.

faqs.q: How can I prevent cavities?
faqs.a: Regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste, cleaning between teeth, limiting frequent sugary snacks and drinks, and routine dental visits can help reduce cavity risk.

faqs.q: What are the signs of gum disease?
faqs.a: Red, swollen or bleeding gums, persistent bad breath, gum recession, loose teeth or pain while chewing can be signs that need a dental examination.

faqs.q: What options are there for replacing missing teeth?
faqs.a: Depending on your mouth and needs, options may include implants, bridges or dentures. The dentist can explain the trade-offs after examining you.

faqs.q: Can you help with dental anxiety?
faqs.a: The team aims to provide calm, patient-centred care, explain each step and give you time to ask questions. Tell us what would help you feel more comfortable.

faqs.q: How do I know if I need a root canal?
faqs.a: Persistent tooth pain, sensitivity that lingers, swelling or a darkening tooth can have several causes. A dental examination and any needed X-rays help determine the cause and treatment.

faqs.q: What are veneers?
faqs.a: Veneers are thin shells bonded to the front of teeth to change their appearance. A dentist can explain whether they are appropriate and what alternatives may suit you.

faqs.q: How can I keep teeth white after whitening?
faqs.a: Follow the dentist's care instructions, maintain daily oral hygiene and discuss any staining or sensitivity. Your dentist can advise on safe maintenance for your teeth.

faqs.q: What causes bad breath?
faqs.a: Bad breath can have different causes, including oral hygiene issues, gum problems or dry mouth. If it persists, a dental check-up can help identify what is going on.

faqs.q: Do I need to have my wisdom teeth removed?
faqs.a: Not everyone needs wisdom teeth removed. Pain, infection, decay or impaction may require assessment; a dentist can examine the area and discuss options.

faqs.q: What is fluoride treatment?
faqs.a: Fluoride can help strengthen tooth enamel and reduce cavity risk. Ask your dentist whether an in-clinic fluoride treatment is appropriate for you or your child.

faqs.q: Can adults get braces?
faqs.a: Orthodontic treatment can be considered at different ages. A consultation can assess your bite and explain options such as braces or clear aligners.

faqs.q: What are clear aligners?
faqs.a: Clear aligners are removable trays designed to move teeth gradually. Suitability depends on your bite and treatment goals, which are assessed by an orthodontic provider.

faqs.q: Are dental X-rays safe?
faqs.a: The dentist recommends X-rays only when they are useful for diagnosis or planning and will explain why they are needed and what precautions are used.

faqs.q: What are dental sealants, and who might need them?
faqs.a: Sealants are protective coatings placed on the chewing surfaces of some teeth to help reduce cavity risk. A dentist can advise whether they are suitable, especially for children.

faqs.q: How can I schedule an appointment?
faqs.a: Call the clinic, message us on WhatsApp, or use the online booking link. Sunday visits are by appointment.
